title: Something Bigger Than Yourself
coreMove: Tie endurance to service beyond personal pride so difficulty has a reason larger than ego survival.
sourcePressure: This chapter belongs to Will, so it must teach endurance, acceptance, and inner governance when control is partial. No source sidecar exists for ch26; this plan is grounded in the frozen TOC title and part placement only, with no named anecdotes invented. For "Something Bigger Than Yourself", the pressure is to teach this exact move: Tie endurance to service beyond personal pride so difficulty has a reason larger than ego survival.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: The weak version turns the chapter into vague toughness or acceptance slogans instead of disciplined endurance under partial control. For "Something Bigger Than Yourself", avoid replacing the chapter move with the whole book thesis.
